text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
â...Hey, Helios~!? Where are you~!? 
Geez! What was the point of chasing me all 
over the place, anyway~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, all by myself now, huh? If I go 
back to the hotel... City's there... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah... seriously, I'm an idiot! I'm 
such an idiot. ...Come on!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Acting so obvious like that... of course 
it'd piss City off. She totally hates 
being lied to.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I was just... getting carried away on my 
own. When City honestly didn't care about 
any of it...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't even ask her how she really 
feels. Scaredy-cat, weakling, idiot, 
dummy...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, I hate this. I hate myself...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: âFound you, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What? I was behaving myself, you know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *exhale*... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I DON'T GET IT AT ALLLLLLLLLLL!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, keep it down! What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I seriously do not get it! Why are both 
you and City moping around like thisssss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My role models are hot-blooded school 
dramas and my dad's old stories! I was 
always taught to tackle things head-on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough the rival! By clashing 
directly, we came to understand each 
other! I took pride in earning mutual 
respect that way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And yet you two are totally different, and 
I just can't understand it! As 
Disciplinary Committee Chair, as your 
senior... it's completely pathetic of 
meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I still want to help! So... I'm 
borrowing the power of the ocean! If a 
head-on clash won't work! We'll just shout 
it at the seaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"............ Haaah!?!? 
Why would I!?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Just let all your feelings out, osu! 
The ocean will accept eeeeeverything, 
osu!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No way in hell! What is this, a manga!? 
That's way too cringe—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Jordan! Am I cringe, osu!? 
When I'm clashing head-on with you right 
now, osu!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"......You're not... cringe. 
The only one who's cringe... is me."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, I just didn't get it anymore...! 
'Aren't we friends!?' Like that...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I've... always cared about her so much. 
I was totally serious...—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"At first, I was just hyped to have a 
model friend... That was all. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: 『...Alright, one more lap...!!』

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Even City was worrying, struggling, and 
working her ass off... 
She was just like me, but so much more 
amazing."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"She's so cool. She works insanely hard, 
she's super stoic... 
Unlike me, she doesn't run away. City is 
just... freaking cool."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to work hard just like City. 
I wanted to become someone I could 
actually like... I looked up to her."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"But you know... I thought maybe she found 
all of that totally annoying, or 
whatever...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Like... maybe City doesn't think of me... 
the same way I think of her... and 
stuff... ngh."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So then! 
What do you want City to tell you, osu!?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh... 
Does City... think of me...—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
DOES SHE ACTUALLY THINK OF ME AS HER 
FRIEND OR NOTTTTTT!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*... *pant*... 
...I'm such an idiot."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —...Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"!? Huh, City... wait, what, why are you 
here!? 
Huh? ...Whaaat!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the hotel's right there. 
I could hear you loud and clear..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Gyaaaaaah!! 
Bamboo-san, your tail!! Hide me!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Not happening, osu! Or rather, this is no 
time to hide, osu. 
Shouldn't you listen to City's answer, 
osu?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Uwaaaah! No, I'm good, forget it!! 
I don't wanna hear it!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't say that. 
Listen to what I have to say, too. Even if 
it might come out a bit clumsy..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really know how to put it. To 
be honest... 
At first, I thought you were seriously 
annoying."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"C-Can you blame me!? You were acting like 
a total fan girl! 
You didn't take the hint when I brushed 
you off, and you were super persistent..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"But... I was happy. Yeah, honestly... it 
made me happy. 
Because nobody had ever approached me like 
that before."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—When you've been modeling since you were 
little, everyone around you is either a 
rival trying to tear you down, or someone 
just using you as an accessory."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So I decided I didn't need friends. All I 
needed was running. 
...I kept my guard up when I entered 
Tracen Academy. But—"
